translator_notes: Origin unclear; the polished wording may be a newer composed song but I cannot name an author. 'Сал јадови... душа пламнаа' is my reading ('only sorrows set my soul aflame'); 'зборој' is a dialect plural of 'зборови'.

lines.cyr: Јас поминав, момче, сношти крај тебе
lines.lat: Jas pominav, momče, snošti kraj tebe
lines.en: I passed by you last night, boy,

lines.cyr: и посакав, лудо, да си со мене.
lines.lat: i posakav, ludo, da si so mene.
lines.en: and I wished, foolishly, that you were with me.

lines.cyr: кој ли сега, мило либе, нив ги бакнува?
lines.lat: koj li sega, milo libe, niv gi baknuva?
lines.en: who is kissing them now, dear love?
Only sorrows, boy, set my soul aflame,
three years, love, made an age.

lines.cyr: кој ли сега, мило либе, нив ги бакнува?
lines.lat: koj li sega, milo libe, niv gi baknuva?
lines.en: who is kissing them now, dear love?

lines.cyr: Ако ми кажеш ти, момче, зборој сакани,
lines.lat: Ako mi kažeš ti, momče, zboroj sakani,
lines.en: If you tell me, boy, beloved words,

lines.cyr: ако ми ветиш ти, либе, љубов без рани.
lines.lat: ako mi vetiš ti, libe, ljubov bez rani.
lines.en: if you promise me, love, a love without wounds.
